title: It Just Works: Niche Optimization Pack
description: This is a modpack designed as a niche replacement for Sodium to ensure core shader compatibility
body:
I hadn't yet figured out how to get my core-shader-rewriting resource packs to work with Sodium. So I made this modpack to make the game run _better_ than in Vanilla while not harming compatibility with my _resource pack_ shenanigans. For that reason it likely won't release on versions pre-1.21.11 unless I update my _resource pack_ to an earlier version

Feel free to use this pack any way you want, but it's higly recommended _not_ to use it outside of scenarios when you have to use core-game-shader resource packs and don't have a strong enough PC to run Minecraft at stable FPS
